content: The wiki has no controls page. "left" was rejected as unknown input — likely the valid ids are things like "primary"/"use"/"action". I'll try a single interact with "primary" first, and if that fails, fall back to raw_input key presses. Since I can't test mid-plan, I'll structure the plan to try "primary" on the notice board, then use raw_input as a fallback for the farming work.

args.approach: Button id "left" was rejected as unknown-input, so this time I use "primary" for interact (and raw_input key presses as a fallback path) — read the notice board, then till/plant/water three meadow tiles to pass days until the day-5 pass reopening, then walk the east corridor to the shrine chest.
